name: Fabric Minecraft
description: Fabric loader Minecraft server — lightweight modding platform.
installScript:
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq unzip >/dev/null
MC_VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
INSTALLER=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '.[0].version')
if [ "$MC_VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi
LOADER=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[0].version')
echo "Downloading Fabric $MC_VERSION loader $LOADER"
curl -s -o fabric-installer.jar "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/$MC_VERSION/$LOADER/$INSTALLER/1.0.3/server/jar"
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

configs.content:
server-ip=
server-port={{SERVER_PORT}}
motd=A StrixMC Fabric Server
max-players=20
online-mode=true
